# Code & Contract Generation

To prevent human error, typos, and schema drift between the Laravel backend and Flutter frontend, the Laravel package provides built-in Artisan code generators.

---

## 1. Generating Null-Safe Dart Models

Instead of manually typing Dart models to mirror Laravel Eloquent models, run:

```bash
php artisan flutter:generate-model Post
```

### What It Generates
The command inspects the Eloquent model's database columns and `$casts` array, outputting a complete null-safe Dart class:

```dart
// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND
// Generated by Laravel Flutter Bridge

class Post {
  final int? id;
  final String? title;
  final String? content;
  final int? userId;
  final DateTime? createdAt;
  final DateTime? updatedAt;

  const Post({
    this.id,
    this.title,
    this.content,
    this.userId,
    this.createdAt,
    this.updatedAt,
  });

  factory Post.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return Post(
      id: json['id'] != null ? int.tryParse(json['id'].toString()) : null,
      title: json['title'] as String?,
      content: json['content'] as String?,
      userId: json['user_id'] != null ? int.tryParse(json['user_id'].toString()) : null,
      createdAt: json['created_at'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['created_at'].toString()) : null,
      updatedAt: json['updated_at'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['updated_at'].toString()) : null,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'title': title,
      'content': content,
      'user_id': userId,
      'created_at': createdAt?.toIso8601String(),
      'updated_at': updatedAt?.toIso8601String(),
    };
  }
}
```

---

## 2. Exporting Strongly-Typed API Routes

Hardcoding endpoint paths like `'/api/users/profile'` throughout your mobile codebase causes bugs when routes change on the backend.

Export your registered Laravel routes directly to a typed Dart registry:

```bash
php artisan flutter:export-routes --prefix=api
```

### Resulting Dart File (`laravel_routes.g.dart`)
```dart
// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND
// Generated by Laravel Flutter Bridge

class LaravelApiRoutes {
  LaravelApiRoutes._();

  /// [POST] /api/flutter/auth/login
  static const String flutterAuthLogin = '/api/flutter/auth/login';

  /// [POST] /api/flutter/auth/register
  static const String flutterAuthRegister = '/api/flutter/auth/register';

  /// [GET] /api/flutter/auth/me
  static const String flutterAuthMe = '/api/flutter/auth/me';

  /// [POST] /api/flutter/devices/register
  static const String flutterDevicesRegister = '/api/flutter/devices/register';
}
```

Now you can use `LaravelApiRoutes.flutterAuthLogin` in your Flutter calls!
